column1: # The NuGet packages the shader translator's NativeAOT build restores (dm/tools/release_mac.sh), with the sha512 NuGet records for each
# (<package>/<version>/<package>.<version>.nupkg.sha512 in the release cache). A package that changes, or one not listed, stops the release;
# after a deliberate change, release_mac.sh --update-nuget-pins rewrites this file (and tools_version must move).
